Phytoplankton in a three-stressor mesocosm experiment

Source: R/data.R
polazzo_phytoplankton.Rd

Phytoplankton densities from the mesocosm experiment of Polazzo & Rico (2021) with an insecticide, a herbicide and nutrient enrichment, sampled once before the pesticide application and three times after it.

Usage

polazzo_phytoplankton

Format

A data frame with 96 rows (24 mesocosms x 4 sampling days) and 77 columns:

mesocosm, insecticide, herbicide, nutrients

As in polazzo_zooplankton.

day

Day relative to the pesticide application (integer: -5, 7, 15, 50).

total_density

Sum of the 71 taxon columns.

The taxon columns hold the density of each taxon found in the source file on any sampling day, whose name for the taxon is given above and in the attribute "taxa". Densities are as reported in the source file, which does not state their unit. The source has one sheet per sampling day, each with the taxa found that day in some mesocosm; a taxon missing from a sheet was not found that day, so its density is zero. Zeros are taxa not found in the sample; there are no missing values.

Source

Polazzo, F., & Rico, A. (2021). Data from: Effects of multiple stressors on the dimensionality of ecological stability. Dryad, doi:10.5061/dryad.qfttdz0gt . Licence CC0 1.0. Sheets "Phyto_D-5", "Phyto_D7", "Phyto_D15" and "Phyto_D50" of Polazzo_and_Rico_2021_EcologyLetters_Full_data.xlsx (the day of the last sheet is taken from its name: its day column says 15); script data-raw/polazzo_rico_2021.R of the source repository.

Experimental design

Twenty-four outdoor mesocosms, three per combination of a full factorial of chlorpyrifos (insecticide, 1 µg/L, or absent), diuron (herbicide, 18 µg/L, or absent) and nutrients (750 µg/L N and 75 µg/L P added twice a week, or ambient). The nutrient additions started four weeks before the pesticide application (day 0). The community tables polazzo_zooplankton, polazzo_phytoplankton and polazzo_macroinvertebrates share the mesocosm codes and the design columns, so they can be joined by mesocosm and, where the sampling days coincide, day.

References

Polazzo, F., & Rico, A. (2021). Effects of multiple stressors on the dimensionality of ecological stability. Ecology Letters, 24(8), 1594–1606. doi:10.1111/ele.13770

See also

Other data of Polazzo and Rico (2021): polazzo_macroinvertebrates, polazzo_zooplankton

Examples

range(polazzo_phytoplankton$total_density)
#> [1]     16 181676
# Taxa found in each sample
taxa <- names(attr(polazzo_phytoplankton, "taxa"))
summary(rowSums(polazzo_phytoplankton[taxa] > 0))
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#>    2.00    7.00   10.00   10.02   12.00   21.00
